sloka: यथा यथा समीपं स हनुमानुपसर्पति ।तथा तथा रावणं सा तं सीता परिशङ्कते ।। ५.३४.९।।।।
transliteration: yathā yathā samīpaṁ sa hanumānupasarpati ।tathā tathā rāvaṇaṁ sā taṁ sītā pariśaṅkate ।। 5.34.9।।।।

translations.english: As Hanuman started slowly drawing close, Sita suspected he might be Ravana.
